<observations>
Date: Jun 9, 2026
* 🔴 User aims to allocate 15% monthly to emergency fund and pay off high-interest credit card debt within 6 months ($400/mo goal).
* 🟡 Agent tracked utility bill increase (12% due to new HVAC installed 05-12-2026) and drafted tax deduction list in cloud folder "Tax Docs".

Date: Jun 12, 2026
* 🔴 User wants to reallocate 10% discretionary spend to a travel fund and refinance mortgage to lower monthly payment ($120 reduction found).
* ✅ Agent emailed mortgage refinance options summary and rate comparison sheet.

Date: Jun 15, 2026
* 🔴 User wants to add $200/mo to emergency fund, asked about student loan refinancing (2.8% option saves $35/mo), set up electricity bill auto-pay, and asked about 0% APR promotional period on credit card balance (eligible under $5k for 12 mos).
* ✅ Agent updated cash flow, emailed student loan recommendation, and logged utility discount.

Date: Jun 18, 2026
* 🔴 User increased 401(k) contribution by 2%, asked about traditional IRA rollover tax deductions, and set up recurring $500/mo transfer to Horizon Savings (1.5% APY). Also asked about tax-advantaged REITs.
* ✅ Agent confirmed IRA rollover maintains tax deduction eligibility, emailed summary, and set up Horizon Savings transfer.

Date: Jun 22, 2026
* 🔴 User adjusted emergency fund target to $10,000, asked about using HELOC (3.5% APR) for business startup, and reviewed credit card bill/fees.
* ✅ Agent retrieved credit score (760), emailed HELOC proposal PDF, and emailed credit card annual fee comparison summary.

Date: Jun 26, 2026
* 🔴 (07:15) User increased 401(k) contribution rate to 12% of gross salary.
* 🔴 (09:00) User asked about rolling over old IRA into Roth IRA.
  * ✅ (10:45) Agent confirmed conversion tax estimate of $3,500 and emailed user.
* 🔴 (12:00) User requested breakdown of potential mortgage interest deductions for next tax year.
  * ✅ (14:00) Agent emailed deduction report and added calendar reminder.
* 🟡 (16:10) Agent generated comparative analysis of robo-advisor platforms VestorPrime and AutoGrow.
* 🔴 (17:45) User asked if AutoGrow offers socially responsible investing options.
* 🔴 (18:30) User stated their car loan has 38 months remaining.
* 🟢 (19:30) Agent replied that AutoGrow supports ESG portfolios and scheduled a follow-up call at 20:30.
</observations>

<current-task>
- Primary: Follow up with the user regarding AutoGrow's ESG portfolio options and robo-advisor comparison during the scheduled 20:30 session.
- Secondary: Review car loan details (38 months remaining).
</current-task>

<suggested-response>
"I can walk you through AutoGrow's ESG portfolio options and discuss your car loan details during our follow-up."
</suggested-response>
